definitions: A category of various porcelain or ceramic items that do not fit into more specific classifications, often including decorative pieces, small dishes, or figurines.
A collection of diverse Chinese porcelain or ceramic objects, typically of lesser individual value or without a cohesive set.
examples: The auction lot included a box of Miscellaneous China.
She inherited a shelf full of Miscellaneous China from her grandmother.
We need to sort through the Miscellaneous China to see if there are any hidden gems.
